creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A pane moved to another workspace leaves its old id in the mirror, and the moved pane loses its Muster name. herdr gives a cross-workspace move a new pane id, and `pane_moved` carries `previous_pane_id`, which nothing in Muster reads. The name registry does not rebind the name to the new id.

So the old row stays as a phantom (`a_2Mi2uGGxX`'s symptom by a different path), and the process in the moved pane keeps a `$MUSTER_PANE` no pane answers to.

Found by slot 2 of the 2026-09-12 round, reading herdr v0.8.0 `src/workspace.rs` (`register_new_pane_with_number`). Not reproduced against a daemon.
title: A pane moved across workspaces leaves its old id in the mirror
